spans.s:
1. मृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see p. 793, col. 1),
washed, cleansed, clean, pure; smeared, besmeared;
prepared, dressed, savoury, (मृष्टम् अन्नम्, deli-
cate food, dainties; cf. मिष्ट); (अम्), n. pepper.
—मृष्ट-गन्ध, अस्, m. (probably) an agreeable
[]
or appetizing smell or savour.
—मृष्टगन्ध-
पवन, अस्, m. a fragrant breeze.
—मृष्ट-तम,
अस्, आ, अम्, exceedingly delicate or savoury.
—मृ-
ष्ट-लुञ्चित, अस्, आ, अम्, torn up (as a root) and
washed.
—मृष्ट-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. containing
a form of rt. 1. मृज्.
—मृष्ट-वाक्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
speaking sweetly (= मिष्ट-वाक्य).
—मृष्ट-
सलिल, अस्, आ, अम्, having bright or pure water.

2. मृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. and 3. see under
rts. 1. मृज् and 3. मृष्), touched, stroked, rubbed,
handled; considered, reflected upon, deliberated.
3. मृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, sprinkled.

मृष्ट मृष्ट. See under rts. 1. मृज्, 1. मृश्,
and 3. मृष्.

1. मृष्टि, इस्, f. (for 2. see p. 793, col. 1), cleans-
ing, cleaning, preparation, dressing (of food, Manu
III. 255

); a savoury repast, (according to Kullūka
= अन्नादेः संस्कार-विशेष.)

2. मृष्टि, इस्, f. (for 1. and 3. see p. 792, col. 1,
and this page, col. 2), touching, stroking, contact.

3. मृष्टि, इस्, f. (for 1. and 2. see under rts.
1. मृज् and 1. मृश्), sprinkling.

मृष्टेरुक, अस्, आ, अम्, eating dainties or deli-
cacies, luxurious, selfish; liberal.

मृश् 1. मृश् (often confounded with
rt. 1. मृष्), cl. 6. P. मृशति (some-
times also A. मृशते), ममर्श, मर्क्ष्यति or
म्रक्ष्यति, अमृक्षत् or अमार्क्षीत् or अम्रा-
क्षीत्, मर्ष्टुम् or म्रष्टुम्, to touch, stroke,
handle; to rub, rub off; to touch (mentally), con-
sider, reflect, deliberate; [cf. Lat. mulc-e-o, (pro-
bably also) mulc-o: perhaps Hib. mear, ‘a finger,
toe;’ mearacht, ‘fingering or touching a musical
instrument.’]

2. मृश्, क्, क्, क्, (at the end of comps.) one who
strokes or touches, a stroker, (see
Gram. 181

मृष् 1. मृष् (often confounded with
rt. 1. मृश्), cl. 4. P. A. मृष्यति, -ते
(rarely cl. 1. P. A. मर्षति, -ते), ममर्ष, म-
मृषे, मर्षिष्यति, -ते, अमर्षीत् (ep. अमृ-
षत्), अमर्षिष्ट, मर्षितुम्, to bear, endure,
suffer; to permit, let, allow; to bear patiently, (मु-
हूर्तम् मृष्यताम्, have patience for a moment);
to forget, let slip (from the mind), neglect; to par-
don, forgive, excuse; cl. 10. P. A. or Caus. मर्ष-
यति, -ते (according to Vopa-deva also मृषयति,
-ते), -यितुम्, Aor. अमीमृषत् or अममर्षत्,
अमीमृषत or अममर्षत, to bear, suffer;
endure, tolerate, allow, put up with; to forgive,
excuse, pardon; [cf. Goth. marzjan; Old Germ.
marrjan; Angl. Sax. myrran.]

2. मृष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, (at the end of comps.) one who
bears or endures, bearing, (see
Gram. 181

मृष् 3. मृष् (connected with rt. 2.
मिष्), cl. 1. P. मर्षति, ममर्ष,
मर्षितुम्, to sprinkle, pour out.
मृशय मृशय for मृचय, q. v.

मृषाय (fr. मृषा), Nom. A. मृषायते,
&c., to err, be mistaken, hold a wrong notion or
opinion.

मृषा, ind. (probably an old inst. fr. a form
मृष, and perhaps meaning originally ‘with for-
getfulness’), in vain, to no purpose, uselessly; wrongly,
incorrectly, falsely, untruly, untruthfully, lyingly,
feignedly, (sometimes used like a substantive, e. g.
वर्जनीयम् मृषा बुधैः, untruthfulness is to
be avoided by the wise); मृषा कृ, to act falsely,
feign; Mṛṣā, as ‘Untruth,’ is personfied as the wife
of A-dharma.
—मृषा-ज्ञान, अम्, n. false or spu-
rious knowledge, ignorance, folly.
—मृषा-त्व,
अम्, n. incorrectness, falsity.
—मृषा-दान, अम्,
n. ‘false gift,’ feigned or insincere promise of a gift.
—मृषा-दृष्टि, इस्, इस्, इ, having a false view or
opinion.
—मृषाध्यायिन् (˚षा-अध्˚), ई, m. a
species of crane, Ardea Nivea, (compared to a reli-
gious hypocrite, hence its names तापस, दाम्भिक,
तीर्थ-सेविन्.)
—मृषानुशासिन् (˚षा-अन्˚), ई, इनी,
इ, punishing unjustly.
—मृषा-भाषिन्, ई, इणी, इ,
speaking falsely or untruthfully, a liar.
—मृषार्-
थक (˚षा-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having a false
sense or meaning, untrue, absurd; (अम्), n. an
impossibility, absurdity (as a rabbit's horn, &c.).
—मृषा-वाच्, क्, f. an untrue or satirical speech,
sarcasm, irony.
—मृषा-वाद, अस्, m. an untrue
speech, lie; sarcasm, irony; (अस्, आ, अम्), speaking
falsely or untruthfully, a liar.
—मृषा-वादिन्, ई,
इनी, इ, speaking falsely or untruthfully, a liar; (ई),
m. one who brings forward an unjust or unfounded
charge, a false accuser.
—मृषोद्य (˚षा-उद्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, speaking untruthfully, lying, a liar; (अम्),
n. untruthfulness, lying.
मृषित in अप-मृषित, q. v.
मृषालक मृषालक, अस्, m. the mango tree.
